rationale: The assistant explained E18 as a drain fault, gave the right order of checks (unplug, emergency hose, filter, impeller) and kept safety in view, including drying the floor and a power-off impeller check. The fix was reached with no part recommended. Minor weaknesses: after the hum, it said the impeller was 'jammed' with some confidence before anything was found, and it told the customer to 'poke a finger' into the pump opening. It also mentioned that a failed pump 'probably' explains E18 returning, which was only conditional and reasonable. The final steps repeated the earlier instructions slightly but caused no blockage.
